### Location
- **Paper section / page / equation:** (e.g., Section 4.2, p. 11, Eq. (4.3))
- **Lean file & line (if applicable):** (e.g., `lean/src/Readable/Step1_ProductFormulaAndPinch.lean:42`)

### Description of the Issue
Clearly describe the error, counterexample, missing hypothesis, or mismatch with the Lean declaration.

### Suggested Fix (optional)
If you have a concrete correction or reference, please include it here.
